item.title: Linux, Eight Months Hence: Reflections on Daily Driving
item.description: Back in mid October of last year (2025), I made the decision to switch to Linux. This switch was a long time coming, even though I only realized in the last two years that I’d be able to make the switch. I’ve talked about my experiences with this migration in previous posts, including the very rough start I had. However, after a few weeks of adjustment and changing up my workflow, I’d like to jot down some thoughts I have in hopes of maybe helping other people realize that Linux is viable for most people in this day and age.
